items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: And you know, uh, Fate Marble? You heard of Fate Marble? From the boat?

ctx.x: Oh plenty. Plenty, I've heard about him. Ice and Snow? Yeah. I was one of his good nombos too. You heard of Tony, huh? Oh yeah. Well a lot of guys used to talk about him.
Oh he's a master. And you know, uh, Fate Marble? You heard of Fate Marble? From the boat?
Yeah. Yeah you know him too. Well that's where, you know. He made one record, you know, but I don't think it really showed him off too good, you know.
